name: Terracore Stones
description: Terracore Stones is your sourcing partner inside India for marble, granite, limestone, basalt, and custom stone. We handle procurement, on-ground QA, and export logistics for architects and developers.

faq.question: What stone does Terracore source?
faq.answer: Marble, granite, limestone, basalt, and custom stone from India.

faq.question: Does Terracore mark up the material?
faq.answer: No. Terracore charges no markup on material; you pay for sourcing, QA, and logistics.

faq.question: Who does Terracore work with?
faq.answer: Architects and developers who need reliable stone procurement from India with on-ground quality assurance.
